summary: DarkPulse, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose an exclusive patent license agreement with the U.S. Navy (NAWCWD). Terms: $15,000 upfront fee, 5% running royalty on net sales (excluding U.S. government sales), escalating minimum annual royalties starting at $10,000 in year three, and a four-year commercialization obligation. No equity, change of control, or special-situation structure. This is a routine intellectual property licensing arrangement, not an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other transformative event. The registrant is the licensee (issuer).
